standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing of the higher Tor pro-systems for a perfect complex modulo powers of an ideal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Algebra, the lemma that the pro-systems Tor_{-p}(H^q, A/I^n A) vanish for p > 0
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the collapsing of the spectral sequence computing H^0(M^bullet/I^n M^bullet), showing that this pro-system is a quotient system and hence Mittag-Leffler.

core_obligations: Reduce to a pro-system of modules over the completion (proof lines 6218-6238): write the reduction of K modulo I^n as a constant sheaf on E_n; then E_1 is perfect, and choosing locally defined maps E_{n+1} -> E_n inducing isomorphisms after tensoring with Lambda/I^n, the lifting lemma produces a finite complex M^bullet of finite projective modules over the completion with M^bullet/I^n M^bullet isomorphic to E_n compatibly with the transition maps.

Compare the given pro-system with the one coming from M^bullet (proof lines 6240-6258): for any triple n > m > k the maps between the sections H^0(X, K tensor^L Lambda/I^n) are compatible with the maps between the sections H^0(X, M^bullet/I^n M^bullet) because any isomorphism over Lambda/I^n induces isomorphisms modulo I^m and I^k; hence it suffices to prove Mittag-Leffler for the latter system.

Finish (proof lines 6260-6283): sections over the weakly contractible affine X are exact, so it suffices to prove that the pro-system H^0(M^bullet/I^n M^bullet) is Mittag-Leffler; the spectral sequence Tor_{-p}(H^q(M^bullet), A/I^n A) converging to H^{p+q}(M^bullet/I^n M^bullet) has vanishing higher Tor pro-systems, so the pro-system in degree zero agrees with the pro-system H^0(M^bullet)/I^n H^0(M^bullet), which satisfies Mittag-Leffler by the usual behaviour of the I-adic filtration on a finite module.
proof_roadmap: Translate the hypothesis into a compatible system of perfect complexes modulo the powers of the ideal and lift it to the completion.
Compare the given pro-system of sections with the one computed from that lift.
Use the collapsing spectral sequence to identify the pro-system with an I-adic quotient system, which is Mittag-Leffler.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a weakly contractible affine scheme, a Noetherian ring Lambda, an ideal I and a constructible complex K whose reductions modulo I^n are constant, the pro-system of H^0 over the pro-etale site with coefficients in K tensor^L Lambda/I^n satisfies Mittag-Leffler (statement lines 6204-6216). The proof (proof lines 6218-6285) lifts the compatible system of perfect complexes to the completion, compares the pro-systems of sections, and identifies the resulting pro-system with an I-adic quotient system through a collapsing spectral sequence. H2: a three-step reduction with four inputs, written out in full.
